title: [bug][linuxdeploy] Linux AppImage script fails
body:
### Describe the bug

Trying to build on Linux (amd64) for Linux (amd64), running `tauri build` is failing on AppImage step. I went through the list of existing issues on the topic, but couldn't find any relevant info to my specific case

```
Error [tauri_cli] failed to bundle project: error running appimage.sh
```

I hit a bunch of `find: Permission denied` errors (why that script would require root access?) and a bunch of `strip: Unable to recognise the format of the input file`

### Reproduction

`cargo tauri build --verbose`

### Expected behavior

build and generate the AppImage
